The '''CR-43 Low-Ride Gossbey Racing Edition''' was a 2.44-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] model of racing [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] manufactured by the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. It was only legal for usage in [[swoopchasing]], but a variant known as the [[CR-43XA]] could be legally used on the streets.
